name: sql-editor
title: SqlEditor
description: A SQL editor on Monaco, loaded lazily from the app's own bundle (no CDN, no network), themed from the editor.* and syntax.* tokens of its region in every preset, mode and density, with run-at-cursor, error markers and a read-only mode.

manifest.name: sql-editor
manifest.title: SqlEditor
manifest.description: A SQL editor on Monaco, loaded lazily from the app's own bundle (no CDN, no network), themed from the editor.* and syntax.* tokens of its region in every preset, mode and density, with run-at-cursor, error markers and a read-only mode.
manifest.usage: Use SqlEditor for real queries: a query tab (variant="ghost", className="h-full") or a bordered field (variant="outline", the default, 240 px high; set the height with className). Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) calls onRun with the selection, or the statement under the cursor, and the statements it holds; markers take offsets into the text (a PostgreSQL error position minus one). Monaco loads on first mount; until then a textarea with the same text and keys stands in, so nothing waits. Monaco has one theme per page: the editor mounted, focused or rethemed last sets the colours of every editor. Use Textarea for short SQL in a form, CodeInput for one-line expressions, and CodeBlock to show code.

props.name: variant
props.description: outline: a bordered field with radius.md. ghost: no border, to fill a pane such as a query tab.

props.name: value
props.description: The text, when controlled; a new value replaces the text as one undoable edit.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the whole text after every change.

props.name: onRun
props.description: Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS): { text, start, end, source: "selection" | "statement", statements }. With several statements in a selection, statements lists each (run the first).

props.name: markers
props.description: Underlined problems: { start, end?, message, severity? } with offsets into the text; without end, the word at start. A hover shows the message; F8 goes to the next.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Text can be selected, searched and copied but not changed; sets data-readonly.

props.name: language
props.description: The Monaco grammar: PostgreSQL or generic SQL.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the editor is empty.

props.name: lineNumbers
props.description: Line numbers in the gutter, in editor.gutter.

props.name: tabMovesFocus
props.description: Tab moves focus out instead of indenting; Ctrl+M (Ctrl+Shift+M on macOS) toggles this at any time.

props.name: screenReaderOptimized
props.description: Monaco's screen reader mode (accessibilitySupport "on"); off means Monaco detects one.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the text area; or pass aria-labelledby with the id of a visible label.

props.name: onEditorReady
props.description: Called once Monaco has mounted, with the editor instance and the Monaco API, for features beyond these props (completions, extra actions).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own; set the height here (h-full in a pane).

slots.name: root
slots.description: The frame: data-slot="sql-editor", data-variant, and the state attributes. Monaco's tokens are read from its region.

slots.name: fallback
slots.description: data-slot="sql-editor-fallback": the stand-in textarea while Monaco loads, with the same text, colours, Ctrl+Enter and accessible name.

slots.name: surface
slots.description: data-slot="sql-editor-surface": where Monaco renders, hidden until it has loaded.

states.name: focused
states.description: The text area has focus: a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the frame.

states.name: loading
states.description: Monaco is loading (aria-busy); the fallback textarea works meanwhile and the pointer shows progress.

states.name: read-only
states.description: Read-only: the outline border lightens to color.border.default.

accessibility: The text area is Monaco's own input (a textarea or an EditContext with role textbox), named by aria-label ("SQL editor" by default) or aria-labelledby; the stand-in textarea has the same name.
Tab indents inside the editor, as code editors do; Ctrl+M (Ctrl+Shift+M on macOS) switches Tab to move focus, and tabMovesFocus starts in that mode, so focus is never trapped.
Every action has a key: Ctrl+Enter runs, Ctrl+F finds, Ctrl+/ comments, F8 and Shift+F8 move between error markers, F1 opens Monaco's command list.
Error markers are announced through Monaco's hover and the F8 marker widget, not by colour alone; editor.* and syntax.* colours are contrast-checked by the token build in every mode.
screenReaderOptimized turns on Monaco's screen reader mode (offer it as a setting); otherwise Monaco detects a screen reader.
Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring on the frame. Nothing is fetched: Monaco, its worker and its font come from the app's bundle.
